text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects and role in my overall portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my average cost.","Selling winners feels satisfying, but repeatedly taking gains early can leave me underinvested in stocks that keep rising; I should use a consistent plan rather than chase the feeling of locking in profit.","A large loss in Stock C showed me that refusing to admit a mistake can be costly; I should set clear risk limits and reassess a position objectively instead of letting my purchase price dictate whether I sell."]}
